tooltips.datasetId: Numeric 15-17 digit dataset/pixel ID from Meta Events Manager.
tooltips.accessToken: Token generated at Events Manager → Settings → Conversions API → Generate access token.
tooltips.testEventCode: If set, all events are sent as test events (visible in Events Manager → Test Events tab).
tooltips.leadEventSource: Sent as custom_data.lead_event_source. Identifies the CRM in Meta dashboards.
tooltips.isDefault: Use this dataset as fallback when a Funnel has no explicit dataset configured.
